mapper.select: SELECT calc_version_id FROM dim_calc_versions WHERE current_flag AND status = 'approved'
SELECT run_id, assumption_set_id FROM fact_prioritization_runs WHERE status = 'approved' ORDER BY run_at DESC, run_id DESC LIMIT 1

WITH s AS (SELECT ST_GeomFromEWKB(decode(#{scope}, 'hex')) AS g), l AS (SELECT d.district_id FROM dim_districts d, s WHERE d.geom && s.g ORDER BY ST_Area(ST_Intersection(d.geom, s.g)) DESC LIMIT 1), sc AS (SELECT stage, overall_score FROM fact_district_scores WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM l) AND calc_version_id = #{version}), pd AS (SELECT existing_sqm, area_required_sqm FROM fact_parks_demand WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM l) AND calc_version_id = #{version} LIMIT 1), b AS (SELECT total_capex, total_opex, total_capex_tier_target FROM fact_budget WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM l) AND calc_version_id = #{version} LIMIT 1), c AS (SELECT lower(trim(coalesce(approved_classification, suggested_classification))) AS tier, coalesce(classification_triggers, '{}'::jsonb) AS tr FROM fact_prioritization_district_classification WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM l)::text LIMIT 1) SELECT (SELECT district_id FROM l) AS liv_district_id, coalesce((SELECT p.in_scope FROM param_district_scope p WHERE p.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM l)), false) AS in_scope, (SELECT overall_score FROM sc WHERE stage = 'Existing') AS score_existing, (SELECT overall_score FROM sc WHERE stage = 'Pipeline') AS score_current, (SELECT overall_score FROM sc WHERE stage = 'AP50') AS score_target, (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_facilities f, s WHERE f.geom && s.g AND ST_Intersects(s.g, ST_PointOnSurface(f.geom)) AND f.stage = 'Existing' AND f.facility_type IN ('Park_Local', 'Park_Neighbourhoud', 'Park_District', 'Park_Other')) AS parks, (SELECT existing_sqm / 10000.0 FROM pd) AS park_area_ha, (SELECT greatest(area_required_sqm - existing_sqm, 0) / 10000.0 FROM pd) AS park_gap_ha, (SELECT total_capex FROM b) AS capex_aed, (SELECT total_opex FROM b) AS opex_aed, (SELECT total_capex_tier_target FROM b) AS capex_tier_target_aed, (SELECT tier FROM c) AS tier, (SELECT CASE tier WHEN 'high_priority' THEN CASE WHEN coalesce((tr ->> 'critical_citizen_risk')::boolean, false) THEN 'H1' WHEN coalesce((tr ->> 'critical_significant_economic')::boolean, false) THEN 'H2' WHEN coalesce((tr ->> 'critical_total_population_risk')::boolean, false) THEN 'H3' ELSE 'H1' END WHEN 'priority' THEN CASE WHEN coalesce((tr ->> 'high_citizen_tier')::boolean, false) THEN 'P1' WHEN coalesce((tr ->> 'high_risk_area')::boolean, false) THEN 'P2' WHEN coalesce((tr ->> 'high_social_impact')::boolean, false) THEN 'P3' WHEN coalesce((tr ->> 'high_future_economic')::boolean, false) THEN 'P4' ELSE 'P1' END WHEN 'remaining' THEN 'R' END FROM c) AS tier_rule, (SELECT string_agg(t, ',') FROM c, jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(tr -> 'triggered') = 'array' THEN tr -> 'triggered' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) t) AS tier_triggers

WITH t AS (SELECT lower(trim(coalesce(approved_classification, suggested_classification))) AS tier FROM fact_prioritization_district_classification WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND district_id = #{livDistrictId}::text LIMIT 1), reg AS (SELECT display_label, source_key, lower(trim(ad_lens_classification)) AS cat, display_order, display_id FROM param_facility_score_display WHERE active AND assessment_type = 'FPP'), sc AS (SELECT r.display_label, r.cat, r.display_order, r.display_id, CASE WHEN f.is_not_required OR f.existing_kpi IS NULL OR f.existing_kpi >= 9000 THEN NULL ELSE round(least(f.existing_kpi, 100)::numeric, 2) END AS s_existing, CASE WHEN f.is_not_required OR f.pipeline_kpi IS NULL OR f.pipeline_kpi >= 9000 THEN NULL ELSE round(least(f.pipeline_kpi, 100)::numeric, 2) END AS s_pipeline, CASE WHEN f.is_not_required OR f.displayed_score IS NULL OR f.displayed_score >= 9000 THEN NULL ELSE round(least(f.displayed_score, 100)::numeric, 2) END AS s_ap50 FROM reg r JOIN fact_fpp_scores f ON f.facility_type = r.source_key AND f.district_id = #{livDistrictId} AND f.calc_version_id = #{version} WHERE r.source_key <> 'Parks' UNION ALL SELECT r.display_label, r.cat, r.display_order, r.display_id, CASE WHEN p.area_required_sqm > 0 THEN round(least(p.kpi_existing, 100)::numeric, 2) END, CASE WHEN p.area_required_sqm > 0 THEN round(least(p.kpi_post_pipeline, 100)::numeric, 2) END, CASE WHEN p.area_required_sqm > 0 THEN round(least(p.kpi_liv_ap, 100)::numeric, 2) END FROM reg r JOIN fact_parks_demand p ON p.district_id = #{livDistrictId} AND p.calc_version_id = #{version} WHERE r.source_key = 'Parks') SELECT sc.display_label AS facility, sc.cat AS category, sc.s_existing AS score_existing, sc.s_pipeline AS score_pipeline, sc.s_ap50 AS score_ap50, m.target_pct AS target_pct, round(m.target_pct - sc.s_pipeline, 2) AS gap FROM sc JOIN param_prioritization_target_matrix m ON m.assumption_set_id = #{assumptionSetId} AND m.assessment_group = 'Tier' AND lower(trim(m.district_classification)) = (SELECT tier FROM t) AND lower(trim(m.category_classification)) = sc.cat WHERE sc.s_pipeline IS NOT NULL AND m.target_pct IS NOT NULL AND m.target_pct - sc.s_pipeline > 0 ORDER BY gap DESC, sc.display_order, sc.display_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.facility_type, coalesce(t.facility_type_label, t.facility_type) AS type_label, t.category, coalesce(t.category_label, t.category) AS category_label FROM dim_facility_types t WHERE t.category IN ('Culture_And_Literature', 'Education', 'Health_And_Wellbeing', 'Infrastructure', 'Leisure_And_Entertainment', 'Saftey_And_Security', 'Social_Infrastructure', 'Sport_And_Recreation') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_facilities f WHERE f.facility_type = t.facility_type) ORDER BY t.category, t.facility_type

WITH s AS (SELECT ST_GeomFromEWKB(decode(#{scope}, 'hex')) AS g) SELECT f.facility_type, count(*)::int AS n FROM fact_facilities f, s WHERE f.geom && s.g AND ST_Intersects(s.g, ST_PointOnSurface(f.geom)) AND f.stage = 'Existing' AND f.facility_type IN #{t} GROUP BY f.facility_type
SELECT max(updated_at)::date FROM fact_district_scores WHERE calc_version_id = #{version}
